proposal.summary: CacheService.xml in SolarWinds MSP PME (before 1.1.15) is writable by normal users, allowing modification of SISServerURL to point to an attacker-controlled server; the service then downloads and executes attacker-supplied binaries, resulting in system-level code execution.
proposal.cwe_quote: The XML file CacheService.xml in %PROGRAMDATA%\SolarWinds MSP\SolarWinds.MSP.CacheService\config\ is writable by normal users, so that the parameter SISServerURL can be changed, which controls the location of the updates.

AV.quote: Any user on the system who is in group users can change the file content.

PR.quote: Any user on the system who is in group users can change the file content.

S.quote: After a certain time the executable file is executed by SolarWinds MSP RPC Server service and establishes a connection with the rights of the system user to the attacker.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm and deploy the vendor fix (upgrade to PME 1.1.15) and issue guidance to customers to verify/restore secure NTFS permissions on CacheService.xml immediately; for triage, identify affected hosts and check for unauthorized downloads/executions in %PROGRAMDATA%\SolarWinds MSP\SolarWinds.MSP.CacheService\cache and PME\archives.
